title: Waiting Time for Professional Assessment of Persons with Disabilities
what_it_is: Waiting Time for Professional Assessment of Persons with Disabilities

sections.label: Wait times for child assessments
sections.summary: Median wait times for initial assessment appointments for children with developmental problems ranged from seven to 19 days.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: As at October 2015, for pre-schoolers aged six years and below, who have developmental problems, the median wait time for an appointment for an initial assessment by a doctor at KKH and NUH is between seven and 17 days.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For children of schooling age, the corresponding median waiting time for an appointment at KKH, NUH and IMH is between six and 19 days.

sections.label: DSP suitability assessment times
sections.summary: Assessment for DSP suitability took below four weeks from referral, with average referral-to-assessment time about three months in 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The time taken for assessment for suitability for the DSP is below four weeks from the time of referral.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The average time taken between referral and assessment for suitability was about three months in 2015.

sections.label: Case assessment and service wait times
sections.summary: In 2015, median case assessment completion was about 2.5 months, day care referral-to-assessment around three months, and home-based and drop-in services one to three months.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In 2015, the median time taken to complete a case assessment was about 2.5 months.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The time taken from referral to assessment for day care services was around three months in 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For services, such as home-based care and drop-in services, the waiting time was between one and three months.

sections.label: New centres with places
sections.summary: Three new centres with about 400 places will open in the second half of the year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Three new centres with about 400 places will be opened in the second half of the year.
